app.name: Homa
app.tagline: Find the day that works for everyone.

auth.firstUserNote: The first account on this Homa becomes its admin.
auth.name: Name

onboarding.title: Welcome to Homa, {{name}}
onboarding.intro: A few choices before you start. You can change them later in settings.
onboarding.visibility: Who can see when you're busy by default?
onboarding.visibilityFreeBusy: People I share with see free or busy
onboarding.visibilityDetails: People I share with see event details
onboarding.comingSoon: Saving this choice arrives with sharing; for now it's only a preview.

editor.title: Title
editor.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
editor.readOnly: This event is from a read-only calendar and can't be changed here.

scope.question: Which events should this apply to?

settings.title: Settings
settings.homeZoneHint: Your calendar is shown in this zone. You can view another one from the calendar.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.note: Letter keys work on any keyboard layout. Shortcuts pause while you type in a field.

setup.title: Set up your Homa
setup.intro: This Homa is new. Make the admin account, check how the instance works, then choose your own settings.
setup.accountIntro: This account runs the instance: it can change the settings in the next step at any time.
setup.instanceIntro: These apply to everyone on this Homa. The defaults suit most people; you can change them later under Settings.
setup.personalIntro: Now your own settings. Everyone who joins later chooses theirs too.
setup.done: All set. Your Homa is ready.
setup.codeHint: The 4 digits Homa printed in its server log when it started (look for "first-run setup code").

instance.title: Instance settings
instance.name: Instance name

signUpsOption.open: Anyone who can reach this Homa

signUpsHint.open: The sign-in page links to sign-up.
signUpsHint.closed: Only existing accounts can sign in. The sign-up page goes away.

instance.defaultLanguageHint: Used until someone picks a language on their device.
instance.defaultsHint: New accounts start with this; each person can change their own.

importExport.title: Import and export
importExport.importHint: Add events from an .ics file exported from Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar or another app. Importing the same file again updates those events.
importExport.exportHint: Download your settings, calendars and events as a JSON file, for a backup or to move to another Homa.

connections.title: Connected calendars
connections.hint: Subscribe to a calendar feed (an .ics or webcal address from Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar, a sports team or a school), add public holidays, or connect a CalDAV account (iCloud, Fastmail, Nextcloud) or a Google account to sync both ways.
connections.urlHint: An https or webcal link ending in .ics. Private links are stored encrypted.
connections.name: Name
connections.nameHint: Optional. Leave empty to use the calendar's own name.
connections.removeBody: "{{name}}" and its events will be removed from Homa. The original calendar isn't changed.

caldav.title: Connect a CalDAV account

hints.icloud: Use an app-specific password from account.apple.com, not your Apple Account password.
hints.fastmail: Create an app password for CalDAV under Settings → Privacy & Security in Fastmail.
hints.nextcloud: Your server's address followed by /remote.php/dav, for example https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav. Create an app password under Settings → Security.
hints.other: The address of your CalDAV server. Homa also tries /.well-known/caldav on it.

caldav.passwordHint: Stored encrypted. Homa never shows it again.
caldav.chooseHint: Checked calendars sync both ways. Unchecking one removes it from Homa only, not from the server.
caldav.noCalendars: This account has no calendars with events.
caldav.removeBody: "{{name}}" and its calendars will be removed from Homa. Nothing on the server is changed.

calendars.title: Calendars
calendars.hint: Pick a color for each calendar, and choose which ones show in the calendar views. Hidden calendars keep syncing.
calendars.suggested: The swatches above stay readable in light and dark themes.

errors.denied: Google wasn't connected: access wasn't granted.
errors.state: Google wasn't connected: the request expired or didn't come from this browser. Try again.
errors.failed: Google wasn't connected. Try again, and allow Homa to see and edit your calendars.
